job.job_description:
Exp - 3- 7 years
Level - Consultant/ Senior Consultant
Skill - DataBrick Engineer
Location - Hyderabad/ Pune/ Bangalore
Work model - Hybrid ( 2days WFO)

F2F interview on 31st Jan 26 in Hyderabad


Qualifications




Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:

310 years of experience in data engineering with significant Databricks on Azure expertise
Strong knowledge of Python, SQL, and PySpark (Scala optional)
Experience building metadata-driven ingestion and data quality (DQ) frameworks using PySpark
Solid grasp of Lakehouse architecture, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and other key big data technologies
Proven team collaboration abilities and excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:

Cloud databases and storage (ADLS Gen2, Azure Key Vault, Cosmos DB, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse)
Data toolsets (data warehouse, data marts, data lake, 3NF, dimensional models)
Building pipelines using Delta Live Tables, Autoloader, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow
Databricks Unity Catalog and implementation of fine-grained access control
Performance tuning in Databricks/Apache Spark



Education:

BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university






If interested, share your profile on sheetal.s@anlage.co.in





Thanks & Regards

Sheetal Shewale
